description: Severe sewage chamber overflow spreading across the primary road near Karve Statue. Foul odor and stagnant wastewater blocking pedestrian access to bus stop.

evidence_summary: Dark blackish effluent overflowing from round manhole cover onto asphalt; creates hazardous walking conditions.

description: Deep 1.5-foot crater on Baner High Street causing severe two-wheeler skidding during evening rush hour.
location_text: Near Balewadi High Street junction, Baner, Pune
evidence_summary: Extensive asphalt breakdown exposing base gravel with jagged edges over a 2-meter diameter span.

description: Chronic open waste dump accumulating outside Phoenix Marketcity rear entrance. Stray cattle and dogs scattering plastic bags.
location_text: Behind Phoenix Marketcity, Viman Nagar, Pune

description: Four consecutive street light poles completely non-functional between Goodluck Chowk and Ferguson College Gate.

description: High-pressure potable water pipeline rupture gushing clean treated drinking water across Katraj Dairy road.
location_text: Opposite Katraj Dairy, Pune-Satara Road, Katraj, Pune
